reviewMethod: Only the explicitly listed references are approved. Previously inspected human specimens retain their original evidence timestamps; new sources have actual source-page screenshot evidence and caption/rights review. No source images are bundled.

axial-brain-mri.title: Normal axial T2-weighted MR image of the brain
axial-brain-mri.creator: Novaksean; cropped version by Mikael Häggström
axial-brain-mri.matches: Actual axial T2 brain MRI at the lateral ventricles; inspected image shows a transverse human head/brain section with both hemispheres and ventricles.
axial-brain-mri.viewLimitations: A regional transverse imaging example, not a gross section, whole-body photograph, or a matched donor for the sagittal/coronal specimens.
axial-brain-mri.linkingTerms: Ordinary Commons file-page link. The source identifies the author and CC BY-SA 4.0; no image reuse is performed.
axial-brain-mri.reproductionRights: CC BY-SA 4.0 stated on the file page; no reproduction or embedding in the app.

human-smooth-muscle.title: Uterus. Human. Progravid. H&E. — slide 66
human-smooth-muscle.source: Columbia University Department of Pathology and Cell Biology
human-smooth-muscle.creator: Columbia University Department of Pathology and Cell Biology; individual slide photographer not separately named
human-smooth-muscle.matches: The human uterine section shows a broad myometrial smooth-muscle region. The linked laboratory commentary specifically describes fascicles arranged in different planes and distinguishes the myometrium from endometrium.
human-smooth-muscle.viewLimitations: A real organ section requiring the slide viewer's zoom, not isolated idealized spindle cells. Different section planes cross smooth-muscle fascicles; the bottom glandular region is endometrium, not muscle.
human-smooth-muscle.linkingTerms: Public university slide page, ordinary outbound link. Visible footer identifies content CC BY-SA 4.0 separately from GPLv3 viewer code. No image or viewer is embedded.
human-smooth-muscle.reproductionRights: Page footer states content CC BY-SA 4.0. The slide itself credits Columbia University Department of Pathology and Cell Biology. No reproduction is performed.

verification.visualEvidence: Actual rendered slide 66 inspected: caption explicitly reads Uterus. Human. Progravid. H&E.; large pink myometrium and adjacent glandular endometrium are visible.
